summary: Backend-only iteration 5 testing for Forge Fitness super-admin & admin user-detail features. Added 12 new pytest cases in test_super_admin_and_detail.py and ran the full suite: 76/76 passed (48 base + 16 iter4 + 12 new). Verified: (1) Super-admin auto-grant — POST /api/auth/register for myscraptv@gmail.com returns user.is_admin=true; subsequent POST /api/auth/login returns is_admin=true; GET /api/auth/me reflects the flag; a freshly registered normal user has is_admin=false. (2) Admin user-detail endpoint — GET /api/admin/users/{uid}/detail (as admin@forge.app) returns keys user (no password_hash), metrics (bmi + calorie_target present), sessions (each with date/name/duration/volume/total_sets/exercises[].sets[].weight/reps/done), weight, measurements, prs, and totals {workouts, volume, duration}. Data was populated by registering a throwaway user, PUTting profile w/ birthdate, adding weight+measurement, and logging a session — every field was cross-checked in the aggregated response. Super-admin can also call the endpoint (verified against admin@forge.app). Unknown user id returns 404. (3) Access control — /api/admin/users and /api/admin/users/{id}/detail return 401 without token and 403 for a normal (non-admin) user. (4) Profile birthdate — PUT /api/profile accepts birthdate='1995-06-15' and GET /api/auth/me reflects profile.birthdate. (5) REGRESSION — the full pre-existing suite (auth, sessions volume/new_prs/xp, gamification, dashboard, diary, foods/search, admin content CRUD, exercises/suggestions, settings default_rest/rest_autostart/water_goal) all still pass. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1235 lines — should be split into routers (auth, profile/settings, foods, exercises/sessions, admin, photos) for maintainability.
SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL is hardcoded ('myscraptv@gmail.com'). Consider reading it from an env var (e.g. SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL) so it can be rotated without a code change.
admin_user_detail streams full sessions (to_list(300)) and weight (to_list(1000)) — fine now, but for heavy users add pagination or a lighter list view.
ProfileIn.birthdate is a free-form str; consider validating with a pydantic date type or regex (YYYY-MM-DD) to prevent bad data ending up in profile.
SettingsIn / ProfileIn still use body.dict() — Pydantic v2 recommends model_dump().
seed_data_creation: Registered super-admin myscraptv@gmail.com/super123 (if not already present), a module-scoped TEST_normal_{hex}@forge.app for access-control tests, and a per-test TEST_detailtgt_{hex}@forge.app populated with profile+birthdate+weight+measurement+session used to verify the admin detail endpoint aggregation. All artefacts prefixed TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/ (test_forge_backend.py, test_admin_content_and_foods.py, test_progressive_and_settings.py, test_super_admin_and_detail.py). Run non-parallel: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q -o addopts='' . BASE URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Super-admin email SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL='myscraptv@gmail.com' is auto-granted is_admin on register/login and re-affirmed on startup. GET /api/admin/users/{uid}/detail (require_admin) returns {user (no password_hash), metrics, sessions, weight, measurements, prs, totals:{workouts,volume,duration}}. The super-admin fixture uses register-first, falling back to login with a small list of candidate passwords ('super123','SuperAdmin123!','Admin123!','super1234'); if the account already exists with a different pw, super-admin tests are skipped rather than failing.
